entries.frase: Added sidebar button (☰) on home screen next to Ojito logo that opens session list dialog (DialogSessionList) - in packages/opencode/src/cli/cmd/tui/routes/home.tsx

Home sidebar toggle con ☰ en home.tsx que muestra facetas y habilidades (skills como Habilidades anidadas dentro de Facetas). Session sidebar también movió SkillsList dentro de Facetas y renombró Skills → Habilidades.

Replaced static facet system (loadFacets/facet-registry/facets.json) with dynamic facet-skills system. computeFacetsFromSkills(skills) derives facets from available skills + built-in tools (websearch, bash, read, write, edit, grep, glob, webfetch, task). computeExperienceBlend(sessions, messages, parts, facets) computes blend from ALL session messages with recency weighting. Skills that don't match any facet category get their own auto-generated facet. Both home sidebar (home.tsx) and session sidebar (sidebar.tsx) updated to use the new logic, replacing detectFacetBlend/matchSkillsToFacets/loadFacets calls. Old facet-registry.ts and facets.json no longer imported.

Separated personality from skills: facets renamed to "Personalidad" (3 static traits: Hacer, Decir, Saber based on system prompt tone). Skills moved to standalone "Caja de Herramientas" section listing all skills + built-in tools as a flat list. No more skill→facet classification. file: facet-skills.ts exports getPersonalityFacets() and getAllSkills(skills). Both home sidebar (home.tsx) and session sidebar (sidebar.tsx) updated with this layout. Old detectFacetBlend/computeFacetsFromSkills/computeSkillDistribution code removed from imports and usage. computeExperienceBlend kept in facet-skills.ts but unused.

Personality now derived from actual system prompt (default.txt). loadPersonality() reads prompt file, parses section headers (# Tone and style, # Proactiveness, etc.) and final tone line to extract traits with real percentages. Traits displayed as bars (▓) with % labels in both home and session sidebars. Hacer/Decir/Saber replaced by dynamic traits like Brevedad, Humor, Precisión, Crítica, Ejecución. Skills remain as standalone Caja de Herramientas.

Complete rename from "ojito" to "haz" across the codebase: terminal title, User-Agent, service identifiers (@haz/Memory, @haz/SystemPrompt), theme name, all CLI command references (haz run, haz serve, haz upgrade, etc.), config file references (haz.json, ~/.config/haz/), error messages, tips, product names (haz Zen, haz Go), splash screen, and uninstall text. Only Prisma ORM references in lsp/server.ts left untouched (unrelated database tool). Banner in logo.ts replaced with cleaner 5-line HAZ ASCII art (█/space, 20 chars wide).

Created ProjectPanel component (left sidebar) with project/subagent/circuit management. Files: component/project-panel.tsx (interactive UI with expand/collapse, inline editing via dialogs, cron config, agent enable/disable, circuit connections with visual arrows), util/projects-storage.ts (types for Project/SubAgent/Circuit + JSON persistence to .haz/projects.json). Integrated into session/index.tsx layout with ⊞ toggle button next to prompt, overlay for narrow screens. Data persisted locally with 500ms debounced auto-save.

Fixed three issues in project-panel.tsx: (1) Added stopPropagation on ProjectPanel root box so clicks inside (like [+]) don't close the panel overlay. (2) Replaced raw cron expression input with intuitive two-mode dialog: presets (Manual, cada 5m/30m/hora/día) or custom expression. (3) Eliminated the `description` function issue in DialogPrompt that caused the cron dialog to hang.

Replaced circuit link dialog (DialogPrompt typing) with two-step DialogSelect for source/target agent selection in LinkDialog component. Added circuit help text explaining the sequential flow. Added ▶ Ejecutar ahora button for manual-cron agents + lastRun timestamp display. Added lastRun?: number to SubAgent type.

Changed all dialog-triggering handlers from onMouseDown to onMouseUp so dialogs don't close on mouseup (click opens dialog after mouse release, avoiding overlay mouseup conflict). Added SubAgentLog type (timestamp, level, message) and log[] to SubAgent with collapsible view in agent detail (▾ historial N). handleRunAgent simulates step-by-step execution, adding log entries per task line with coloring (info=dim, result=green, error=red), auto-expands log panel. Persisted in .haz/projects.json.

Improved agent execution log: handleRunAgent now generates meaningful results via simulateResult() based on task keywords (noticias→ESPN/Olé snippets, analisis→métricas, scrap→estadísticas, etc.). Log entries are expandable: click on ▸ entry to show full detail text below. detail field added to SubAgentLog. expandedEntries Set<string> tracks open entries per agent.

All dialog-triggering handlers changed from onMouseDown to onMouseUp to prevent dialogs from closing on mouse release. Affects CronDialog, LinkDialog, FileEditorDialog, rename prompts, delete confirmations, and all [+]/✕/▶ buttons.
Added maximize/restore toggle for ProjectPanel: □ button in header, isMaximized/onToggleMaximize props, dynamic width prop. ProjectPanel default width 44, expandable via toggle.

Created FileEditorDialog in project-panel.tsx: modal with textarea for editing file content. Files per project stored in ProjectFile[] (path/content/agentId). Auto-generated output/{agent}_{timestamp}.md on each agent execution with task results.

Fixed handleRunAgent in project-panel.tsx: (1) replaced simulateResult() with real agent model calls via SDK (session.create + session.prompt), (2) session.create needs directory + agent params (not just title), (3) SDK response is wrapped in { data, request, response } even with throwOnError: true — must access response.data, (4) each task executes sequentially in same session for context, (5) incremental withSave after each task for live log updates
